opening.argument: The material is presented as practical guidance on moving live seminars and workshops online, grounded in “all of the lessons that I learned last week from doing and transferring all of my live events into online events.” Its business focus is operational: “having a clear call to action with booking links and automation is essential.” The follow-up invitation concerns “an author's breakthrough session or discuss the program options that we had presented on the call,” using scheduling and program-delivery mechanisms rather than an investment promise, credential request, impersonation claim, or deceptive payment mechanism.
